title: QueryNLResponse
description: Natural language query results with matching malware intelligence records.

universal_report.description: URL to the universal report for this entity. Only present for hash entities

intelligence_card.description: URL to the intelligence card for this entity.

Links.description: Related links and references for a malware intelligence record.

returned.description: Number of hits included in the response

QueryCount.description: Count of matching records for a query.

count.description: Number of times the value occurs in the result set

sandbox_score.description: Sandbox score of a hash. Only present for hash entities

file_extensions.title: File Extensions
file_extensions.description: List of file extensions for Hash. Only present for Hash entities

tags.description: List of tags associated with Hash. Only present for Hash entities

QueryHit.description: A single malware intelligence record matching the query criteria.

QueryTotalPages.description: Total number of pages that can be returned by this query
